strengths: Universally relatable physical frustration mechanic with strong visual clarity in the first seconds.
Easily translated into 3D animation with King Robert in a royal bed or throne setting.
Low dependency on original audio or identity context.
concerns: Requires a clear, active player intervention mechanism so the physical annoyance seamlessly transitions into puzzle gameplay.
adaptation_idea: Show King Robert trying to play a game in bed while his oversized royal cape constantly flops onto the screen and disrupts his game, prompting the player to intervene and solve the puzzle.
